title: Command line foundations
description: Ashgrove Print Studio is a two-person screen-print studio on Tanner Row, and years of posters, orders and invoices sit in one laptop folder that nobody can find anything in. You have never typed a command, and you start there: look around, move between folders, then make, copy, move and remove files until the folder is sorted. Each issue teaches one part of the command line in a real shell, one small step at a time.
